jobs.title: Senior Audio Designer (FTC)
jobs.description: About Dambuster Studios Originally founded in 1999 as Free Radical Design our ambition and passion comes through as strongly now as when we first began.  We are always seeking individuals who can emulate our values - passion, quality, and teamwork - which are embodied in our diverse and inclusive culture. Even if you’re not sure that you meet all the criteria for a role, don’t be put off from applying - we want to hear from you.  Our only requirement is that you work from the UK, and if you’re not here right now we can discuss relocation if the role requires you be on-site frequently (if the role requires this, it’s outlined in the advert below).  Our internal Wellbeing Committee and Mental Health First Aiders help ensure that our diversity is championed in a safe environment in our city centre studio. Senior Audio Designer (FTC) Dambuster Studios - creators of the number one BAFTA-nominated smash hit Dead Island 2 -  has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Audio Designer to join our highly talented Audio team on a fixed term contract until June 2028. The role can be offered on site at our Nottingham office, hybrid, or remote within the UK. Please note, this is a senior role, and we are unable to be flexible with the level. Role overview As a Senior Audio Designer, you will work with the rest of the audio department and studio to create high quality audio experiences. This is a highly varied role that can involve many areas of audio design, tackling both creative and technical challenges in a wide variety of settings for many different feature teams. You will leverage your experience to contribute to the success of projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and excellence. You will take ownership of your work, proactively solving problems and taking part in mentoring colleagues to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality outputs that align with the organisation’s goals and vision. What we can offer you Core hours 9.30am – 4pm, remaining hours worked flexibly Relocation support to Nottingham, UK (if required) Holiday allowance that increases with service (to a maximum of 30 days plus statutory public holidays) Inclusion into the studio’s annual pay review (effective 1st July) following 12 months service Company pension contribution that increases with service Private Medical Insurance via AXA Health, including dental and optical cover Life Assurance Scheme via Zurich (x3 salary cover) Company enhanced full pay for maternity leave for the first 26 weeks (to qualifying expectant mothers) Clear career progression within Dambuster Studios Studio funded learning and development opportunities Modern game development environment with the latest technologies Vibrant, modern city centre location with good transport links Travel Loan Scheme for Nottingham-based employees Fully subsidised gym membership with Virgin gym (Nottingham) Quarterly company funded cross-team events such as our Annual Christmas Party, Summer Family BBQ and Teambuilding activities Free financial advice Employee referral bonus scheme Cycle to work scheme Weekly office treats, including breakfast on Monday and pastries on Friday Responsibilities Work within audio styling and priority established by audio leadership Implementation of audio design across a wide variety of systems and game areas Attend departmental and interdepartmental meetings and report back on emerging requirements for audio Work with established project management software Work with your fellow audio colleagues across a range of emerging audio requirements including sound effect creation, dialogue editing/design and music implementation Work within established technical specifications in all work including game engines and audio middleware Record audio in studio environments as well as in the field Takes ownership of assigned work, ensuring quality, efficiency and reliable delivery Contribute to the development and refinement of process, tools and workflow to enhance productivity and quality Keep up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies and practices. Maintain high-quality documentation and up to date work processes, methodologies and solutions Set high standards for others to follow Co-ordinate and possibly attend mocap sessions off-site Requirements Strong sound engineering skills and knowledge of the relevant tools and technology, with a good sense of timing and aural skills needed to make a great sounding game An experienced grasp of interactive audio fundamentals Knowledgeable about methodologies of audio implementation and interactive story telling High level of expertise in DAW software (Preferably Reaper) High proficiency in signal flow, plug-ins, sound design techniques Proven experience in recording (microphone techniques, recording techniques, processing & editing) Significant experience in using game engines such as Unreal Engine and proprietary game software Significant experience in using audio middleware such as Wwise Experience in file management (naming conventions, batch processing, memory profiling & debug analysis) Expert in written & verbal communication Self-managed, displaying both excellent organisational skills to deal with the many thousands of assets in a game, whilst also being able to find ways to be productive when unexpected problems occur Experience mentoring and sharing knowledge across a team Analytical skills to break down game development challenges to inform others Highly organised and can use established studio workflows to meet commitments reliably A track record of delivering high-quality work with attention to detail and a commitment to excellence Proven track record in managing multiple projects, balancing priorities and meeting deadlines Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across teams and disciplines. Equal Opportunities Statement Dambuster Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Anyone considering their next step in their career journey with Dambuster will receive consideration without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity or paternity, or membership in any other legally protected category.  We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees, and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to apply. We operate a transparent recruitment process that removes barriers for those who require reasonable adjustments.  If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or onboarding process, or if you are successful in securing a position with us, please let us know what we can do to ensure your success.

jobs.title: Lead Sound Engineer
jobs.description: Established in 1998 and working in over 30 languages, the Keywords Group is one of the leaders in the provision of localisation services to the Video games and Software Localisation markets worldwide. Keywords is an international technical service provider to the global Video Game Industry with offices in Montreal, Dublin, London, Paris, Milan, New Delhi, Tokyo, Shanghai, Singapore, Pune, Rome, Barcelona, Mexico City, São Paulo, Los Angeles, and Seattle. Working on a worldwide basis, we provide a range of linguistic, testing, and quality control services to Video Game Developers and Publishers alike. Job Summary Reporting to the Global Pre, Rec, Post and QA Manager, the Lead Sound Engineer coordinates the activities of the global team of Sound Engineers in charge of technical audio tasks like postproduction, effects, mastering, levelling and mixing, among others. The Lead Sound Engineer must also collaborate with Project Managers, Audio Asset Managers, Audio QA, Recording Studios and other stakeholders to ensure that there are sufficient resources to meet the deadlines and to deliver all final assets within the agreed deadline, with quality matching or exceeding client expectations, and in a cost-effective way. Main Tasks Being in constant communication with the Global Pre, Rec, Post and QA Manager to share any relevant information about their team, escalate issues, propose ideas. Onboarding, training and mentoring of Sound Engineers. Scheduling and approval of days off among their team members, helping them ensure there are enough internal and freelance resources to attend current and upcoming work. Setting yearly goals and giving regular performance feedback to each member of their team. Coordinate their team during the scouting, onboarding and training of new Sound Engineers. Build productive working relationships with all other Globalize teams, like Project Managers, QA team, Asset Managers, Recording Studio teams, etc. Work closely with Audio Project Managers to understand the scope and requirements of each project, and that they are aware of project QA status. Collaborate with Recording Studio managers and provide them with technical support and Sound Engineer resources, if possible. Manage and adapt planning, workflow and resources according to workload needs. Make independent decisions on work methods while following established standards, procedures, and requirements. Sound Engineer Tasks Prepare recording sessions following best practices or specific project/client/recording studio needs. Follow technical specifications in the tasks they perform. Perform audio postproduction on recorded assets. Work on other audio tasks like mixing, sound effect creation, audio batch analysis and processing, etc. Support Tasks Support the Global Pre, Rec, Post and QA Manager in promoting a culture of collaboration and mutual support within the Globalize team, other Service Lines and Shared Services teams. Contribute to process and tool improvement initiatives at all levels. Work with the Global Pre, Rec, Post and QA Manager to identify Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and produce data-driven analysis of critical functions within their responsibility area. Any other tasks agreed upon at Global Pre, Rec, Post and QA Manager’s request. Technical Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English and other language). Ability to communicate clearly and in a concise manner with all the stakeholders, including the members of this team and the rest of the teams in Globalize. Advanced knowledge of the Audio Localization workflows, processes and tools. Advanced knowledge of digital audio workstations and innovations in the sound field. Advanced knowledge of video games market (publishers, developers, platforms, titles, etc.). Experience in dubbing recording and postproduction for at least 3 years. Experience working in the videogames industry is highly preferred. Behavioural skills Demonstrable evidence of successful collaborative teamwork, team building and people management. Ability to use good judgment to prioritize tasks. Able to manage sensitive and confidential information. Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast paced, complex environment. Able to guide a team proactively and effectively to achieve the desired goals. *Kindly submit your CV in English. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavour to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees. At Keywords Studios, we value and encourage diversity in all its forms. We foster an inclusive environment and give special priority to the inclusion of people with disabilities, as we believe that diversity enriches and strengthens us as a team. This is why a valid disability certificate will be highly valued. Keywords Studios is committed to fair and ethical hiring practices. We expect candidates to conduct themselves with honesty and to participate in all applications and interviews independently, presenting their own knowledge and experience. Candidates should refrain from using AI assistance or third-party tools or services that could influence, capture, or otherwise interfere with the authenticity of the assessment process. When providing your information in this application, you indicate that you understand we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice  https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice/. ---------- Role Information: EN Studio: Keywords Studios Location: Americas, Mexico, Brazil Area of Work: Localization Service: Globalize Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent contract Working Pattern: Hybrid

jobs.title: Lead Sound Designer
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an experienced Lead Sound Designer to join our studio in Warsaw to drive audio development of Witcher 4. As a Lead Sound Designer, you will be responsible for leading the Sound Design team and collaborating with cross-discipline teams to create and deliver an immersive audio experience for our upcoming game. If you are an accomplished game audio artist and experienced leader with a passion for crafting soundscapes for widely respected, narrative-driven RPGs, we want to hear from you! Daily Responsibilities: Lead a team of Sound Designers and drive game audio development in the project. Help define and maintain aesthetic continuity throughout the game and trailers, in alignment with previous releases in the IP where appropriate. Collaborate closely with project Directors, Leads, Producers, and cross-discipline teams (Music, VO, Programmers) to craft immersive, high-quality, and technologically advanced audio experiences. Plan, revise, track, and execute milestones, sprints, and roadmap deliverables. Support and coach team members to achieve impactful and high-quality in-game results while fostering their growth and development. Support the design and development of innovative audio systems using Unreal Engine 5, Wwise middleware, and in-house tools. Design, implement, and mix original and rich sound effects. 7+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, with involvement in multiple shipped AAA titles. At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role related to sound design or audio direction. Strong creative skills and a focus on quality, evidenced by a portfolio, demo reel, or game credits. Collaborative approach to navigating challenges and resolving design obstacles. Exceptional artistic and creative competence. Effective cross-disciplinary communication skills. Ability to manage timelines and coordinate with teams. Skilled communicator experienced in collaborating across development teams and providing supportive leadership to direct reports. Nice to Have: (These skills are not required to apply for the position) Experience with Atmos, Surround Sound, 3D Audio, and HRTF. Experience working with performance capture. Experience planning and executing field and Foley recording sessions. Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you and  tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Paid Leave — from 20 to 26 days of holiday per year, and paid sick leave. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog . A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 31 800 – 43 725 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL
jobs.description:
Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL - 216383 - Electronic Arts Skip to content Electronic Arts Open Roles About EA EA Careers EA News Login English - US Chinese English - US Finnish Français Italian Korean Malay Polish Romanian Spanish Swedish Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL Home ... Open Roles Role Detail General Information Locations : Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Role ID 216383 Worker Type Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Studios - SPORTS Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. EA SPORTS NHL has revolutionised sports gaming for millions of players worldwide. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. Pay Transparency - North America COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$67,000 - $92,700 CAD Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA. In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

jobs.title: Composer / Sound Designer
jobs.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? Playtech's Sound team is looking for a talented Composer/Sound Designer to collaborate with our international team and create immersive in-game music, design sound effects, and prepare sound packages for our online slot games. HOW TO APPLY? A portfolio showcasing music and sound design work created for slot games is a mandatory part of the application. Please submit your CV together with multiple relevant work samples and, where possible, video demonstrations of completed projects. Your influential mission. You will... Create in-game music in a variety of genres for online slot games. Design sound effects and musical parts for animations and game events. Prepare game packages in a variety of sound formats. Edit and mix sound for promo videos. Components for success. You... Possess 1+ years of experience in composing and sound design in the slot industry. Ability to provide examples of completed slot game work, ideally including video demonstrations of the final implementation. Have a passion for composing music and creating engaging audio experiences for players. Have access to a home studio with your own music production setup and extensive SFX libraries. Have experience composing original music across multiple genres, including orchestral, traditional, rock, electronic, and dance. Have a strong understanding of adaptive and interactive game audio, including loopable music, gameplay-driven transitions, anticipation builds, and bonus stingers. Are experienced creating high-quality sound effects for games and interactive products. Demonstrate strong audio editing, arranging, mixing, and mastering skills. Possess advanced proficiency with professional DAWs such as Ableton, Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar. Have strong knowledge of industry-standard plugins, virtual instruments, and modern music production workflows. Are comfortable playing and recording musical instruments as part of the creative process. Understand player behaviour and the role audio plays in engagement and game performance. Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with designers, artists, developers, product teams, and external partners. Are able to work independently and confidently guide the creative direction of projects through music references and concepts. Communicate proficiently in English. You'll get extra points for... Prior experience in the gaming/slot industry. Thrive in a culture that values... Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace. Global scope and inclusive working environment. Constant learning and development opportunities. Active lifestyle and mental well-being. Fun and engaging company events. SOUND TEAM There are several global game production studios within the Playtech family. Each studio is made up of Game Producers, Artists, Animators, Mathematicians, and Developers who collaborate to create high‑quality content for top‑performing games. These games are then distributed to our clients and players around the world. As a Composer/Sound Designer, you will be part of our Ash studio sound creative team and work closely with Game Producers and Studio Artists to bring our content to life through music and sound effects. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

jobs.title: Sound Designer
jobs.description: The Sound Designer is responsible for composing music, crafting sound effects, designing audio implementation, and recording voiceovers for use in games and marketing materials. This position works closely with artists, animators, game designers, and software developers to create immersive and entertaining games. Please be sure to include a link to your portfolio in your application. What You'll Do Use sound to creatively bring games to life. Coordinate with Animators, Game Designers, and Software Developers to create and implement audio. Work closely with Lead Audio Designer to develop creative, technical, and professional skills. Maintain organized project files and asset storage. Detect, resolve, and prevent audio issues in games. Deliver high-quality audio assets on schedule. Manage deliverables of multiple projects concurrently. What We're Looking For Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Music, Audio, and/or Sound Design. Intermediate to Advanced level in Music Composition, Sound Design, and Audio Engineering. Ability to compose music in a wide variety of styles. Ability to receive mentorship and integrate feedback. new_jobs.title: Senior Audio Designer (FTC)
new_jobs.description: About Dambuster Studios Originally founded in 1999 as Free Radical Design our ambition and passion comes through as strongly now as when we first began.  We are always seeking individuals who can emulate our values - passion, quality, and teamwork - which are embodied in our diverse and inclusive culture. Even if you’re not sure that you meet all the criteria for a role, don’t be put off from applying - we want to hear from you.  Our only requirement is that you work from the UK, and if you’re not here right now we can discuss relocation if the role requires you be on-site frequently (if the role requires this, it’s outlined in the advert below).  Our internal Wellbeing Committee and Mental Health First Aiders help ensure that our diversity is championed in a safe environment in our city centre studio. Senior Audio Designer (FTC) Dambuster Studios - creators of the number one BAFTA-nominated smash hit Dead Island 2 -  has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Audio Designer to join our highly talented Audio team on a fixed term contract until June 2028. The role can be offered on site at our Nottingham office, hybrid, or remote within the UK. Please note, this is a senior role, and we are unable to be flexible with the level. Role overview As a Senior Audio Designer, you will work with the rest of the audio department and studio to create high quality audio experiences. This is a highly varied role that can involve many areas of audio design, tackling both creative and technical challenges in a wide variety of settings for many different feature teams. You will leverage your experience to contribute to the success of projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and excellence. You will take ownership of your work, proactively solving problems and taking part in mentoring colleagues to foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality outputs that align with the organisation’s goals and vision. What we can offer you Core hours 9.30am – 4pm, remaining hours worked flexibly Relocation support to Nottingham, UK (if required) Holiday allowance that increases with service (to a maximum of 30 days plus statutory public holidays) Inclusion into the studio’s annual pay review (effective 1st July) following 12 months service Company pension contribution that increases with service Private Medical Insurance via AXA Health, including dental and optical cover Life Assurance Scheme via Zurich (x3 salary cover) Company enhanced full pay for maternity leave for the first 26 weeks (to qualifying expectant mothers) Clear career progression within Dambuster Studios Studio funded learning and development opportunities Modern game development environment with the latest technologies Vibrant, modern city centre location with good transport links Travel Loan Scheme for Nottingham-based employees Fully subsidised gym membership with Virgin gym (Nottingham) Quarterly company funded cross-team events such as our Annual Christmas Party, Summer Family BBQ and Teambuilding activities Free financial advice Employee referral bonus scheme Cycle to work scheme Weekly office treats, including breakfast on Monday and pastries on Friday Responsibilities Work within audio styling and priority established by audio leadership Implementation of audio design across a wide variety of systems and game areas Attend departmental and interdepartmental meetings and report back on emerging requirements for audio Work with established project management software Work with your fellow audio colleagues across a range of emerging audio requirements including sound effect creation, dialogue editing/design and music implementation Work within established technical specifications in all work including game engines and audio middleware Record audio in studio environments as well as in the field Takes ownership of assigned work, ensuring quality, efficiency and reliable delivery Contribute to the development and refinement of process, tools and workflow to enhance productivity and quality Keep up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies and practices. Maintain high-quality documentation and up to date work processes, methodologies and solutions Set high standards for others to follow Co-ordinate and possibly attend mocap sessions off-site Requirements Strong sound engineering skills and knowledge of the relevant tools and technology, with a good sense of timing and aural skills needed to make a great sounding game An experienced grasp of interactive audio fundamentals Knowledgeable about methodologies of audio implementation and interactive story telling High level of expertise in DAW software (Preferably Reaper) High proficiency in signal flow, plug-ins, sound design techniques Proven experience in recording (microphone techniques, recording techniques, processing & editing) Significant experience in using game engines such as Unreal Engine and proprietary game software Significant experience in using audio middleware such as Wwise Experience in file management (naming conventions, batch processing, memory profiling & debug analysis) Expert in written & verbal communication Self-managed, displaying both excellent organisational skills to deal with the many thousands of assets in a game, whilst also being able to find ways to be productive when unexpected problems occur Experience mentoring and sharing knowledge across a team Analytical skills to break down game development challenges to inform others Highly organised and can use established studio workflows to meet commitments reliably A track record of delivering high-quality work with attention to detail and a commitment to excellence Proven track record in managing multiple projects, balancing priorities and meeting deadlines Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across teams and disciplines. Equal Opportunities Statement Dambuster Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Anyone considering their next step in their career journey with Dambuster will receive consideration without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity or paternity, or membership in any other legally protected category.  We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees, and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to apply. We operate a transparent recruitment process that removes barriers for those who require reasonable adjustments.  If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or onboarding process, or if you are successful in securing a position with us, please let us know what we can do to ensure your success.

new_jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
new_jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.
